can you implement the following in src/server/modules/facial_recog/facialrecogserver.js:
POST api/user/<id>/face
Add a new face to be referenced against

PATCH api/user/<id>/face/default
Replace a user’s default face
GET api/user/<id>/face/default
Get the default image of a person’s face made when their account was created
you should first look at how the db handles it in src/server/database/dbcrudmethods.js and src/server/database/db.cjs, the server should also be able to be added in index.js
